result.summary: The home feed is mostly rendered correctly, but one section heading shows a raw, unresolved localization key instead of user-facing text. No other clear visual defects were found; the clipped carousel items and the cut-off bottom card are expected scrolling behavior.

issues.description: The second section heading displays the raw i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a translated title (e.g. 'Popular right now'). The translation string is missing or failed to resolve, exposing an internal identifier to users.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing translation for the 'home_feed.popular_title' key in the active locale and make sure a human-readable fallback string is used when a key cannot be resolved.
